Maybe the sample is preloaded? The tool carbon_nmr_spectra returns spectra for the sample at hand, but we need to know the compound. Could also use IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch. But we need number of carbonyl groups.

We need to get the structure. Perhaps there is a default sample? The system may have a hidden compound. We can try to get IR spectra and look for carbonyl peaks (~1700 cm-1). But counting peaks may be ambiguous.

Better: Use carbon_nmr_spectra to see carbonyl carbon signals (~190-220 ppm). Count them.
